review_comment: The added line introduces template injection via Python's %-formatting with user-controlled substitutions. User-provided values like room_id or token containing % characters will be interpreted as formatting directives, potentially causing KeyError exceptions or email content manipulation. Replace %-formatting with str.format() using explicit key access or escape % characters in substitution values before formatting.

The code sends emails using user-provided addresses without rate limiting, enabling potential email spam. While this represents a resource allocation issue, it better fits CWE-799 (Improper Control of Interaction Frequency) than CWE-770. Implement request rate limiting based on IP address, user session, or target email address to prevent abuse.
